title: I Followed the Blood-Drive Sticker After They Called My Slot a Walk-In

parts.text: I sat in chair four at 10:16 a.m. and the volunteer called my numbered slot a walk-in. My sticker still said 10:15 APPOINTMENT. I was thirty-two, donor, holding a confirmation that listed my name. I photographed the sticker, the chair, and the walk-in line they waved me into. Then I followed the sticker to the lead. At 10:24 the lead pinged a mis-scan. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. They restored my slot. Policy now has a second line: STICKERS ARE NOT WALK-INS. I keep the confirmation. The chairs finally look like a list, not a shuffle.

social.description: 10:15 sticker, chair four, a waved walk-in line. Would you have followed the sticker?
